description: The title screen, stretched to the window. The menu is drawn over its right-hand side.
Behind the Options, Deck Builder and Gauntlet screens.
Imported from the 1997 game (Advfac64.pic): despite the name, the adventure's world-map frame, for the day the overworld is built. NOT READ by the game yet.
Behind the Embark screen of a new adventure: the 1997 character screen's dark scratched field (Menu4.pic), stretched to the window.

The creatures walking the world: the sheets the 1997 game loads for its creatures from Spr/ (the 640 x 480 set), a BODY per creature (BK_FWZ.SPR ... DG_WUG.SPR, 49 of them) and a SHADOW (SFWZ.SPR ... S_DG.SPR, 32, some shared), each keyed world_creature_ and the file's name in lower case. The hero's grid exactly: 40 frames of 154 x 108, five to a row (frame ((heading + 2) & 7) x 5 + step), painted with Advfac64.pic's palette, each beside a .json sidecar whose first top clip (60-73) is the height above the creature's feet the frame's top stands at; a shadow is drawn where its body is.
